answers.reasoning: createImpl does Object.assign(useBoundStore, api), copying getState/setState/subscribe/getInitialState onto the hook as own properties.
The third arg to useSyncExternalStore is the memoized () => selector(api.getInitialState()), the server-snapshot getter.
The module says the useReducer+refs re-check was deleted in #550 when useStore moved to useSyncExternalStore, which now re-checks after subscribing itself.
getState is non-reactive (per the exercise hint): it returns the current value once but subscribes to nothing, so it goes stale until an unrelated re-render happens.
The lesson states React re-runs the selector over fresh state and re-renders only if the result differs from last time via Object.is.
